description:
Post order pack message. Post body to order_pack_id with optional line_id and visible_to; returns message_id or a pending_action_id when an AI requests factory-visible text. messages an AI sends for the factory to see require approval.
留言。用 order_pack_id、body 及可选 line_id、visible_to 留言；返回 message_id，AI 发起工厂可见文字时返回 pending_action_id。AI 发给工厂看的留言要本人点。
name: post_order_pack_message
title: Post order pack message
